steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable the tenant setting that should prevent vendor addition during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ and open its configuration flow.
Provide the mandatory event title for the create screen.
Select the first available RFQ template, corresponding to the requested Buy Template action.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Attempt to add a vendor and require positive evidence that the tenant lock prevents the action.
